reviews.text: Very good, super kind and helpful, recommended

I have a 13-year-old white Molosser mix who is congenitally deaf. He's always had issues with previous groomers, especially when drying, so much so that he had to wear a muzzle. I recently moved to a new neighborhood and, thanks to the positive reviews, I ended up at Mille Bolle Bau. It was a pleasant surprise, especially for the interaction between my dog ​​and Danilo, a very sweet person, who immediately understood the difficulties of a deaf dog and took into account my experience in caring for my own dog. Having volunteered in shelters myself and having seen all sorts of things, I can only praise the expertise of this center.

Dario is truly great.
Professional, kind, and very sweet with our furry friends.
Highly recommended.

We took our Cola for a wash and nail trim. The boys went all cuddle-happy as soon as they saw her. We left, and the puppy happily stayed with them. As soon as she returned, the boy even let me choose what perfume to put on her. Even today, three days later, she still smells great.
When she came out of the groomer, the dog was super happy! What can I say? See you next month! Our Cola can't wait ☺️🫶🏻

Terrible experience with my dog's ultrasound. Not because of the result, but because of the way the dog was treated; to keep him "quiet," we watched through the shop window (the door to the room was open) as the employee, in this case the owner, patted him on the head. We therefore removed our dog before the end of the service, paying in full as agreed, stating that we had seen everything (it should be noted that as soon as he noticed we were observing everything, the gentleman in question closed the door to the room so we could no longer see). However, he replied that it was a "little joke," clumsily denying the evidence. Clearly, we will not be returning.

Negative experience. I took my dog ​​for grooming and he was returned completely shaved because, according to them, he had too many knots.
I understand the challenges of the job, but such an important decision should have been communicated in advance, not made without the owner's consent.

It was a pleasant discovery. I have three dogs and take them regularly. The professionalism and dedication to care set Mille Bolle Bau apart from other groomers. The owner is truly helpful and kind. Highly recommended.

I think the photos really convey what I'm trying to convey. I could recommend you take your pets to these guys because they're good, beautiful, and friendly, and their professionalism is astonishing and rare to find. Maybe that would be too obvious and reductive. You'll just have to try it to believe it. I did, and the prices are spectacular.

Now be the judge. TOP 💕🌈
Courtesy, availability, professionalism and education are rare things to find in animal lovers. Highly recommended.

Hello, we're closed and haven't received any appointments for you. It would be helpful to write something along the lines of the stars to be constructive in your review and avoid creating unnecessary problems.

I went in to make an appointment and was faced with a stifling heat wave.
The guy working was all sweaty; there was no air conditioning.
The place is very small and it was too hot. I didn't make an appointment because I was afraid my dog ​​would suffer heat stroke.
Exceptional knowledgeable people

Among the best groomers in Rome, Diego and especially Danilo are two true professionals in the industry. Qualified, helpful, and always kind to our furry friends and to us, the owners. It's always a pleasure to come back to you.
My dogs are back, shiny and smelling great, and most importantly, they haven't shed tons of hair since I started taking them to them. They're very patient and meticulous.
Excellent, very kind and professional, I highly recommend them!

I discovered this grooming salon by pure chance, and I must say it was the most serendipitous thing of my life.
My dog ​​and I are very happy with it.
Highly recommended.

I've been coming here for three years with my little princess, and I have to say I'm very happy with them.
Friendliness, respect, and professionalism are the cornerstones of their work.
They also offer dental hygiene services without the need for anesthesia, as would be the case in a veterinary practice, and I find this an excellent alternative.
My little girl has severe gum inflammation, and if it weren't for them, I wouldn't have noticed until a few months later, when she would have had her regular veterinary checkup.
Dario, the owner, advised me on the best care and treatment options with great professionalism and kindness.
What can I say? My little girl and I thank you.
If you're looking for a groomer that takes complete care of your four-legged friend, you absolutely must come here.

I brought my two dogs, aged 14 and 13, here, encouraged by the good reviews, hoping to find the patience and attention needed to care for two large dogs, not only in age but also in size. My hopes were more than rewarded: the dogs were very calm and, above all, they came out of the wash smelling good, clean, and with coats that were not even puppy-like. The willingness to accommodate me, both in terms of schedule and management, was truly exceptional, so I give it a 10 and we will definitely be back! Joy and Nanà thank you, and so do I.
Wonderful staff and unparalleled professionalism
Hi, we saw your one-star review. Could you kindly explain your rating by pointing out the points where we can take inspiration for improvement?
Great guys, they know how to work with animals and are professional. I'll definitely be back!
Impeccable grooming. Dario and Danilo are super patient and truly professional. Briciola thanks you. See you next time.

I asked for a quote for the grooming without stripping of my reisen shnauzer: 250 euros if there are no knots!?! I'd be curious to know if they found any knots. The asking price is triple the competition's without shame.
Highly recommended! Kind, welcoming, and knowledgeable. They managed to get my dog ​​to love washing, even though he wasn't used to it! Thank you so much ❤️

Not just a grooming salon, but a place where our furry friends are treated with care and love. Dario is incredibly kind, and you can tell it's not just a job for him, but a true passion and love that he gives to each of his guests, pampering them with infinite sweetness! There's absolutely nothing better than this!
Efficient and helpful. Even though Dagon, a 40-kg Beauceron, was terribly afraid, they managed the appointment with professionalism and serenity. Thank you so much.
Kindness, professionalism and so much love for the puppies entrusted to their hands.

I've been taking my Jack Russell Dom to Dario and Danilo for years... three adjectives to describe their expertise: professional, punctual, and absolutely fair in terms of pricing. I highly recommend their support, even for those with problem dogs.

We agreed over the phone to wash an American Bulldog at €30-€35. We went to the grooming salon and handed the dog over to the staff member with whom we had agreed on the price. So, no problem. The problem arose when it came time to pay for the service, which instead of €30-€35.00 had risen to €45.00 for no apparent reason. Given that my female American Bulldog is a medium-sized dog with the same size and weight as a Labrador, we couldn't justify this price increase, which was also "out of line." In closing the idle matter, we agreed to pay €40.00. Staff or business owners who lure customers into the shop with fair prices and then, once the job is done, ask for a higher price without any excuse. I could have been satisfied with the work and reported it to my friends or relatives who have a faithful four-legged friend at home, but unfortunately, I must say that it was a stagecoach robbery perpetrated on December 23, 2024, for which we worked very hard not to report the incident to the competent authorities for unfair commercial practices. We will certainly never return, first and last time.
I expect a response, but unfortunately that's exactly what happened.
In response to the owner's response (I also attach photos of the dangerous, elderly dog ​​and its neglect):
Unfortunately, I must dispute the entire content of the vague response. First of all, we were never welcomed into the tiny room of your shop because it was occupied by another dog. Consequently, no sign was displayed to allow us, as customers, to see the extremely dangerous dog who handed it over through the private access door to the grooming area, where it was washed and dried without a muzzle. The payment was made within the designated dog washing area (which, incidentally, is not permitted by law). I also disagree that the dog does not fall under the categories you presumptuously cite, "biting, old age, and neglect of the dog." In fact, the dog is not a biter for the reasons mentioned above; it is young (4 years old as of February 2025) and lives in an apartment. While my wife and I were present at your storefront during the dog washing process, the employee who washed the dog never once mentioned the dog's intent to bite. He merely wrinkled his nose at the employee's erroneous maneuvers, which perhaps attempted to force him to do something that bothered him (after the wash, he pointed a blower with a long, narrow nozzle directly at his face). Everyone (except you) knows that dogs do not tolerate jets of air, especially when aimed directly at their heads. During the wash, people passed by and praised the dog's beauty and the loving manner in which he interacted with your staff. The owner of the Labrador you had bathed also complimented him on his beauty and cheerfulness, not recognizing my dog ​​as aggressive—quite the opposite, in fact. It's a shame to try to get ahead of yourself by recounting easily debunked facts. I'd really like to meet the Maltese's owner so I can give you a detailed account of the treatment you gave him throughout the entire drying process. I owed you that much. As for the term "neglect" applied to my dog, you'd like to review the hygiene of the grooming area and the overall appearance of your business. In short, the pot calling the donkey horned...
Dear

If you add a touch of friendliness and courtesy to professionalism, your dog's grooming is guaranteed!

Thanks, Dario and Danilo ❤️
Ettore
Today I found the perfect groomer for my Pippi. Affectionate, professional, and even friendly. Well done!
Dario is a true professional... my dog ​​is in love with him... I recommend him, you won't be disappointed..❤️😘 …

Serious and professional place
Highly recommended
Dario and Danilo are truly special people. They're a loyal customer, and my dog ​​is always happy to return. Professional and courteous. Well done!

A grooming salon where you can bring your furry friend without any worries. Dario is a professional with extraordinary passion and cares deeply about the well-being of animals, always treated with the utmost care.
If you're a bit anxious like me, at Mille Bolle Bau you can finally rest easy ❤️
Very comfortable, clean and efficient

I brought my little long-haired Maltese dog Fiocco. He was full of knots and risked having all his hair cut off... but Dario was very good and professional and my dog's coat now looks beautiful, very clean and smells great.

A highly recommended place for anyone looking for an honest, transparent, and above all, loving and highly trained groomer.
They explained their work to me in detail, they welcomed my puppy with genuine passion, and even though my furry friend is a bit of a mischievous cat, they did a truly excellent job.
A truly wonderful discovery!

Dario is truly number one: I brought my dog, full of knots, and despite everything, he did a great job.
Mille Bolle Bau: HIGHLY RECOMMENDED!!!
Found closed on Friday, number unreachable and half a day wasted

I took Iron to Dario's yesterday for the first time. My furry friend came out shiny and smelling great, with his tail wagging. What can I say? I've received very positive feedback and I'll be back! 😊 …

I had a great experience, professionalism, and high-quality products.
I highly recommend it to everyone!!
